en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a residential street with early 20th‑century multi‑storey tenement houses. In the foreground is a grassy field where several children sit. On the right corner stands a prominent three‑storey building with decorative facade and dormer windows; ground-floor shop signs indicate a bakery and confectionery. A cyclist rides along the unpaved street and two girls walk on the sidewalk. In the distance, industrial buildings and tall chimneys suggest a factory area.
